column3: The phone screen shows the Due Meld HOME screen in light theme, recreated from the attached screenshot: small grey text “Wednesday, October 28”; huge bold plum headline “2 overdue, 3 due this week.”; grey “$2,572.39 due in the next 30 days”; a row of rounded day chips W 28, T 29, F 30, S 31, S 1, M 2 with 28 filled plum; a plum card “Next up · submit to Lincoln Elementary” / bold white “School field trip form” / marigold pill “Due today” / “$25.00” with a round marigold check button; a white row with an orange-red date tile “OCT 25” and “Property tax, 2nd installment” “3 days late” “$1,864.50”. Floating OUTSIDE the phone, overlapping its upper right edge, a glossy iOS notification banner: app icon, “DUE MELD · 9:00 AM”, bold “Car insurance renews in 7 days”, “$412 · Renew with Harbor Mutual”. Behind the phone on the left, a folded paper letter with one date line glowing marigold, as if the app just read it.

The phone screen shows the Due Meld CHECK IT screen in light theme, recreated from the attached screenshot: top “×” and title “Check it”; huge bold plum “We found 1 deadline”; grey “Check the dates. You’re the final say.”; a small thumbnail of a photographed bill; a white card labelled “Deadline”, field “Due date” showing “November 11, 2026” with a small sparkle label “AI read this”; below it a marigold-edged quote box with a sparkle icon: “Payment must be received by November 11, 2026.”; label “What is it?” field “Water bill”; label “What do you need to do?” with chips Renew, Pay (selected, filled plum), Submit, Cancel; a wide marigold button “Save item”. OUTSIDE the phone on the left, a real paper water bill tilted toward the viewer, its line “Payment must be received by November 11, 2026.” highlighted in glowing marigold, with a thin glowing marigold line running from that sentence to the quote box on the phone screen.

The phone screen shows the Due Meld DEADLINE DETAIL screen in DARK theme (near-black plum #141019 background), recreated from the attached screenshot: back arrow; small label “Insurance”; a date tile “NOV 4” (marigold top band); big bold white “Car insurance renewal”; a marigold pill “In 7 days”; a dark card “What to do” / “Renew by November 4, 2026” / “From Harbor Mutual”; a marigold-edged card “Found in the letter” / “Policy renews on 11/04/2026”; section “Reminders at 9:00 AM” with a list: “30 days before — Sent”, “7 days before — Sent”, “1 day before”, “On the day”; bottom buttons “Snooze” (dark) and “Mark done” (marigold). Floating OUTSIDE the phone, overlapping its upper left edge, a large glossy iOS notification card: app icon, “DUE MELD · 9:00 AM”, bold “Car insurance renews in 7 days”, “$412 · Renew with Harbor Mutual”, with two buttons “Done” (green) and “Snooze”. A small glowing marigold bell and calendar icon float near it.
